title: What If You Stopped Drinking Water Completely?

scenes.text: What if you never drank water again? The clock is shorter than you think.
About two-thirds of your body weight is water. Losing even three percent can start dehydration.
On day one you'd feel thirsty and sluggish, and your kidneys would slow down to save water.
Toxins build up. Confusion and dizziness set in, and shock can follow.
By around day three, kidney failure becomes possible, faster in heat or hard exercise.
The twist: your brain is about 73 percent water, which is why confusion is a warning sign.

description:
